svg.title: REAR COVER
svg.text: Wall 2.4; case screw pattern 156 x 125.5; four 3.4 mm clearance holes.
Left-side USB-C aperture 14 x 8. Rear BOOTSEL / RESET service holes;
closed top edge. Dimensions mm; views auto-fitted. PETG / PLA. First print
fit required; use dimension values rather than page scale.
